datasets.name: OpenStreetMap Sangachal AOI vectors (roads/tracks/paths/coastline/terminal)
datasets.resolution: vector (node geometry as returned by Overpass)
steps: read cached Overpass JSON (/tmp/phase01-<layer>.json, geometry per way)
clip each vertex to AOI rect (clamp + clipped flag, features preserved)
project lon/lat -> world metres via src/ring2/site.js geoToWorld
clip every segment to the twin disc (DISC_R = RING_RADIUS_M - 150 = 9850 m; split at crossings, drop fully-outside runs)
round to 0.1 m, emit compact JSON public/data/sangachal-vectors.json
limitations: 946 source ways / 9859 source vertices; 74 fully-outside-disc ways dropped, split ways emit one feature per inside run (flagged c:1 when AOI-clamped)
terminal layer carries OSM tags only — no verified facility layout (binding spec §1A: ESIA layout is historical)
no elevation in source; twin drape samples the DEM field at render time
